entries.85e5f50c6f249692: Operating revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1.4679 trillion, up 7.0% year on year, and net operating revenue was ¥720.4 billion, up 11.5% year on year. Commissions received were ¥478.4 billion, up 14.9% year on year; brokerage commissions rose 23.2% to ¥109.6 billion owing to increased equity trading, and fees for underwriting, secondary offerings and solicitation of sales to specified investors fell 16.7% to ¥39.9 billion owing to fewer equity underwriting deals. Net operating revenue from external customers was ¥278,025 million for the Wealth Management Division, ¥255,511 million for the Global Markets & Investment Banking Division, ¥134,912 million for the Asset Management Division, and ¥15,226 million for Other. The main sources of revenue by division are: for Wealth Management, fees on products and services relating to asset management and administration for individuals and unlisted companies, and net interest margin income from Daiwa Next Bank; for Global Markets, customer flow income and trading income; and for Investment Banking, underwriting and secondary offering fees and M&A fees. Asset Management earns revenue from investment trust management fees, real estate operating income, gains on sale of investees, management fees, dividends, electricity sales income and others.
